historical_references.reference: Umeshvar was a popular name for the Hindu deity Shiva during the medieval period in India. He was especially revered in the region of Kashmir and was often depicted with his consort Parvati and their son, Lord Ganesha.

Another reference to Umeshvar can be found in the Puranic texts, specifically in the Shiva Purana. In this text, Umeshvar is described as the lord of the mountain Meru and the guardian of the universe. He is also mentioned as the supreme deity to whom all other gods pay homage.
